lines.text: The writer investigates everything from the beginning and writes an orderly account so Theophilus may know the certainty.
In Herod's time, the priest Zechariah and his wife Elizabeth, a descendant of Aaron, had no children.
Zechariah was chosen by lot to burn incense, and an angel appeared at the left side of the altar.
The angel said Elizabeth would bear John, who would go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Moses.
Gabriel said Zechariah would be unable to speak until this came to pass, because he did not believe.
